resources.string: Reference information. Examples explain the measurement; they do not describe the current device reading.
General chart reference, not the source status for this historical period. Threshold examples are defaults; each session uses its saved settings.

Samples are grouped into time buckets. The line follows the average; the vertical range shows minimum and maximum. Tap a point to read time and min / average / max. A narrow peak may appear in the maximum even when the average is low. Missing values, pauses and session boundaries can leave gaps; a gap is not zero.

For pressure and overall state, the stepped line shows the highest severity in each time bucket. Tap a point for minimum / average / maximum. A fractional average is an aggregation, not an additional severity code. Pauses, missing readings and session boundaries can leave gaps.
These points use the actual probe timestamp. Wait is accumulated over the recorded probe interval; delay is the lateness of that probe. Compare wait values across similar intervals.

No data can mean no session, no samples in the selected period, a disabled collector or an unavailable source. A missing value does not mean zero or a healthy device. Opening this guide does not start collection or check sources.
No source check is available in this process. Use Check availability in Diagnostics when you want to test enabled sources.
Why a value may be missing
Available: a valid reading was obtained; this says nothing about whether the value is good or bad.
Unsupported: the source is absent or inaccessible to this APK. Recheck after changing device conditions. For CPU, indirect signals can remain available separately.
Read error: no valid value was obtained. A later reading may recover; transient /proc errors are retried no more often than every 30 seconds.
Disabled: the collector or required option is switched off. This is not a device failure. Collection choices apply according to the session settings.
Waiting for a valid interval: a baseline or another reading is needed, or this source is not due for polling yet. The temporary gap is not zero.
No additional error reason was reported.
Android denied access from this APK. Access through an ADB shell can differ from access inside the app.
The required source file was not found on this device.
The required Android API or device implementation is unavailable.
The source could not be parsed into the expected numeric fields.
Reading the source failed; the app has no valid value for this attempt.
Counters changed discontinuously. A new baseline is needed before calculating a difference.
This parameter is disabled by the collector selection or its dependent option.
The first reading establishes a baseline; another valid reading is required to calculate a change.
Collection is paused, for example because screen-off collection is disabled.
A deep-sleep gap breaks the probe interval. Sleep is not counted as CPU scheduling delay.
The probe was too old or could not be paired with a valid current interval, so it was omitted.
The API returned no usable value, or a derived assessment lacks its input.
